name: Camp Robindel
description_short: An all-girls overnight summer camp, running since 1951, with a full seven-week summer session. There is also a two-week introductory session for girls entering 2nd grade.
activities: senior trips: Maine coast camping, white water rafting, rock climbing, Canada trip

sessions.name: 2 Weeks on Winni (introductory, girls entering 2nd grade)

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: All Girls Summer Camp Near You, Camp Robindel Dates & Rates

warnings: Full session dates have no year printed; 2027 assumed from the '2027 Dates & Rates' heading (the weekdays match 2027).
Extra fees: transportation, baggage shipment, optional horseback riding ($1000 regular / $1600 intensive), and senior trips for campers entering 7th grade and up.
Sibling discount for full-session campers: $500 for the second child, $750 for a third.

Payment schedule (seems to apply to the full session): $3500 deposit with application, $3500 by Dec 1, $3500 by Feb 1, balance by Apr 1. The page does not say whether the 2-week program follows the same schedule.
Two director phone numbers are listed (Jolly 215-518-6021, Cori 858-245-9625); only the first is recorded in the phone field.
The page says ACA accredited: check it on acacamps.org and add aca_accredited with aca_source_url
unknowns: Camp street address, city, state and zip (page only mentions 'Lake Winni')
